WAGO
========

Our central I/O PLC is a Modbus based WAGO 750-851?. All I/O features of the sampler are used here. 
The program running on the WAG is programmed using Codesys and can be accessed from the laptop.

Basic functions:
----------------

Smoothes the scale signal and converts it to a calibrated ml amount. Runs flush, fill and empty programs
using the selected input valve and runs the appropriate pumps. If you start Codesys on the laptop you
can connect Codesys with the PLC by pressing Alt+F8 and in the visualization you can see what is happening.


Scale calibration:
------------------

Until now, the scale can only be calibrated using the Codesys visualization - this will change in the future.
However, the process will stay the same:


### Calibrate offset only (every couple of days)

1. Empty the reservoir. This can be done with the right Hardware-Button
1. Press Calibrate until the green led starts to flicker. 
1. Done!

### Calibrate offset and gain (once a week in the beginning, if the values reproduce once a month)

1. Remove the inlet cap from the reservoir
1. Empty the reservoir. This can be done with the right Hardware-Button
1. Enter as target volume 0ml
1. Press Calibrate until the green led starts to flicker. 
1. Pour 500ml water into the reservoir
1. Enter as target volume 500ml
1. Press Calibrate again until the value is not changing 
1. Empty the reservoir
1. Put the inlet cap on the reservoir again
1. Enter as target volume 0ml
1. Press Calibrate until the green led starts to flicker. 
1. Done!

### Calibration values that are *roughly* ok:

 - smooth_factor 100
 - calib_offset 4639.52685546875
 - calib_gain 0.15307874977588654
